description: Rank Hyperliquid traders by realized profit, win rate or volume over 1 day to all time, with filters that remove bots and one-off wallets. Use for "who are the best traders this week?", "find consistent winners on stocks (dex xyz)" or "top traders using builder X". Pair with hydromancer_wallet_overview to see what they hold now.

builder.description: Only traders who have traded through this builder's app.

excludeBots.description: Drop wallets that look automated (human score below 60). Default true.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 25, max 1000).

market.description: Only "main" (native Hyperliquid) or a HIP-3 dex such as "xyz". Omit for all.

name: hydromancer_top_traders
title: Top traders leaderboard
